en.review.microsoft-sentinel.microsoft.sent: Microsoft Sentinel is a cloud-native SIEM and SOAR solution built on Azure. It provides intelligent security analytics and threat intelligence across the enterprise, with deep integration into the Microsoft security ecosystem.
en.review.microsoft-sentinel.security.copil: Security Copilot integration brings generative AI to incident investigation, allowing analysts to use natural language to query security data, understand incidents, and generate reports. This significantly accelerates security operations.
en.review.microsoft-sentinel.for.organizati: For organizations already invested in Microsoft 365 and Azure, Sentinel offers compelling value with seamless data collection and native integrations.
Generative AI for incident investigation, threat hunting, and report generation.
en.review.microsoft-sentinel.serverless.arc: Serverless architecture with automatic scaling and no infrastructure to manage.
en.review.microsoft-sentinel.native.connect: Native connectors for M365, Azure AD, Defender, and entire Microsoft stack.
en.review.microsoft-sentinel.ml-based.anoma: ML-based anomaly detection and customizable correlation rules.
en.review.microsoft-sentinel.logic.apps.int: Logic Apps integration for automated response playbooks.
en.review.microsoft-sentinel.kusto.query.la: Kusto Query Language for powerful data exploration and hunting.
en.review.microsoft-sentinel.costs.can.spik: Costs can spike with data volume
en.review.microsoft-sentinel.enterprise.pri: Enterprise pricing based on deployment scale and features:
en.review.microsoft-sentinel.custom.pricing: Custom pricing based on organization size
en.review.microsoft-sentinel.microsoft.offe: Microsoft offers a comprehensive security certification path covering cloud security, identity management, compliance, and security operations. These role-based certifications align with real-world job responsibilities in modern cloud-first environments.
en.review.microsoft-sentinel.entry-level.ce: Entry-level certification covering security, compliance, and identity concepts across Microsoft cloud services.
en.review.microsoft-sentinel.investigate.re: Investigate, respond to, and hunt for threats using Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, and threat intelligence.

ja.review.microsoft-sentinel.security.copil: Security Copilot の統合は、生成 AI をインシデント調査にもたらし、アナリストが自然言語を使用してセキュリティデータをクエリし、インシデントを理解し、レポートを生成できるようにします。これにより、セキュリティ操作が大幅に加速されます。
